//: The Edge Function runs on Deno, not React Native, so it cannot use the
app's tsconfig: it imports npm: specifiers, uses the Deno global, and
writes explicit .ts extensions on relative imports.
This config typechecks the function's PURE modules (schema.ts, helpers.ts
and their tests), which is what `npm run typecheck:functions` runs.
index.ts is excluded because checking it needs Deno's own types; the
Supabase CLI typechecks it at deploy time, and `deno check` does locally.
vision.test.ts is excluded for the same reason: it imports vision.ts,
which uses the Deno global and an npm: specifier. Jest still runs it
(Babel, not tsc), so the retry and error-handling behaviour it covers is
verified; the types are checked by Deno at deploy time.
